episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: An unconventional team is formed to track escaped convicts when, in the series opener, two U.S. Marshals hire three convicted felons who had escaped from prison, and promise them a month off of their sentences for each capture.

episodes.title: Collected
episodes.summary: A man who hunts women and tortures them escapes during a candlelight vigil outside prison, and the team learns that he has a woman captive in an unknown location.

episodes.title: The Bag Man
episodes.summary: A man with a prosthetic hand escapes and goes on a crime spree, and the team tries to catch him before he crosses the Canadian border.

episodes.title: Out of the Mouths of Babes
episodes.summary: The team hunts a pedophile, and they believe he could be going to the school where he worked and where the children he's accused of molesting attend.

episodes.title: Queen of Hearts
episodes.summary: A woman convicted of stabbing her husband 48 times escapes on a school bus; and Lloyd's gambling debt is on the rise and an inmate threatens his life if he doesn't pay.

episodes.title: Like Father, Like Son
episodes.summary: An antigovernment con with a destructive streak escapes, and the case hits close to home when the man sends a bomb to DuChamp's home. Also, Lowery wants to know the identity of his real father.

episodes.title: Fun with Chemistry
episodes.summary: A Bonnie-and-Clyde-like pair escape and go on a killing spree, and the race is on to catch them before they kill again.

episodes.title: Steaks
episodes.summary: Two inmates escape by poisoning another inmate and hiding in his coffin, but, once outside, there is friction between the two men.

episodes.title: One for the Money
episodes.summary: A jewel thief escapes from prison and the team believes he's plotting a big heist, and the only way to catch him is to discover what the man wants to steal.

episodes.title: Paid in Full
episodes.summary: A contract killer escapes and leaves a trail of bodies, and the team looks for a connection between the victims in order to catch the killer.

episodes.title: Off the Beaten Path
episodes.summary: A schizophrenic with outdoor-survivalist skills escapes and sets out to abduct a young television host and eventually kill her.

episodes.title: There Are Rules
episodes.summary: An 18-wheeler busts through prison walls, and several convicts escape by hiding in an armored car that was in the back of the truck.

episodes.title: Where in the World is Carmen Vega
episodes.summary: In the first-season finale, the head of a drug cartel escapes while attending her son's funeral, and, while the team hunts her, it's suspected that there's a rat in the ranks who's helping the fugitive elude the team.

episodes.title: An Unjust Death
episodes.summary: In the second-season opener, the team hunt a merciless serial killer whom Lloyd's testimony helped convict. Meanwhile, Charlie gets offered a promotion, putting the fate of the program in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Round Two
episodes.summary: A group of convicts use a subterranean tunnel to get to a home near the prison, and one of them is an undercover agent whose allegiance may be compromised.

episodes.title: Double Down
episodes.summary: An escaped police informant is hunted, and his ties to a major felon are uncovered. The situation then intensifies when a member of the team gets kidnapped.

episodes.title: Cruz Control
episodes.summary: An escaped con goes on a killing spree fueled by a hopeless medical diagnosis he received.

episodes.title: Self Help
episodes.summary: The gang must figure out how a prisoner pulled off the perfect crime while remaining incarcerated.

episodes.title: I Smell Emmy
episodes.summary: The team pursues an escaped inmate and a prison volunteer who aided her getaway.

episodes.title: Ain't Love (50) Grand
episodes.summary: A prison escapee kidnaps his former lover after discovering that she has become involved in another relationship.

episodes.title: SEALd Fate
episodes.summary: An ex-Navy SEAL flees prison in order to exact revenge on his former government-contractor employer, setting off conspiracy theories about his motives.

episodes.title: Freakshow
episodes.summary: The gang tracks a fugitive who used to perform in the circus as an escape artist.

episodes.title: Served Cold
episodes.summary: The team face a difficult choice when a case they're barred from being involved in turns personal.
